name: executing-plans
title: executing-plans
description: Executes a written implementation plan inline in the current session: task briefs and a progress ledger shared with subagent-driven-development, test-gated task completion via its task-start/task-done scripts, and stop-and-ask rules for genuine blockers. For when the human chose inline execution or no subagent tool exists.
why: writing-plans produces the plan and SDD executes it with subagents; this is the inline path for harnesses without subagents — the same ledger discipline, with no fabricated dispatches.
